sentences.text: The applicant no.1 is the brother-in-law and the applicant no.2 is the husband of the deceased lady.

The applicants have been convicted under Sections 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860 and have been sentenced to suffer life imprisonment by a judgment and order dated April 5,
2021.
They pray for suspension of sentence.
2. We have heard learned Counsel for the parties.
We have seen the depositions on record.
The prosecution witnesses squarely support the prosecution case.
The post-mortem report also supports the prosecution case.

3. In view of prima facie sufficient incriminating evidence against the applicants, although they are in custody for more than five years and three years respectively, we are not inclined to extend the privilege of suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicants, at this stage.

We see from a departmental note dated December 15, 2025, that the Trial Court Records (TCRs)
have been received by the department.
6. The department is directed to expedite the process of preparation of paper book and ensure that paper book is ready by the end of March, 2026.

7. Place the appeal under the appropriate heading in the Combined Monthly list of April, 2026.
8.

We clarify that the observations made by us in this order are only for the purpose of disposing of the application for suspension of sentence and the same shall have no relevance at the final hearing of the appeal.
9. Criminal Section is directed to make available certified copies of this order to the parties, if applied for, upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
